regime_context: Hong Kong's Hang Seng market shows a narrow eligible set (5 of 17 themes), with Tech Hardware & Semis as the leading eligible narrative. The absolute trend gate (validated for drawdown control) suggests focus on eligible themes; momentum ranks serve only as a focus lens, not alpha. Rotation is not one-narrative and no crowding flags.
emerging_watch: Watch Diversified Miners: currently momentum leader but not eligible; if it passes the absolute trend gate (eligibility flips true) and its momentum score remains above Tech Hardware's for two consecutive weeks, that would signal a leadership handoff. Retire the watch if Miners' eligibility stays false or its momentum advantage erodes below 0.5 for a week.
